scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@build-a-bot/core && npm run build --workspace=@build-a-bot/api && npm run build --workspace=@build-a-bot/studio && npm run build --workspace=build-a-bot
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@build-a-bot/core && echo 'Build-A-Bot Studio: http://localhost:5173' && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names core,api,studio "npm run dev --workspace=@build-a-bot/core" "npm run dev --workspace=@build-a-bot/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@build-a-bot/studio"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@build-a-bot/core && npm run dev --workspace=@build-a-bot/api
